about.title: About me
about.bio: Hi, I'm Lou. I grew up in Brazil and moved to Germany more than 20 years ago. Animation has been my passion since I first moved a puppet one frame at a time, and I'm still chasing new ways to mix styles, techniques and tools until something unexpected comes alive. Off screen you'll find me cooking for friends, making music or rolling through the city on my longboard.

timeline.title: From keyframes…
timeline.y2010: Media Arts studies. Stop motion was my first love and showed me crafts I didn't know I had.
timeline.y2014: Motion designer and video producer. Projects from shooting to finishing, with 2D and 3D animation.
timeline.y2022: Got curious about what happens behind the screen and started coding. First small web projects, then full-stack apps and a game. Code became another way to animate.
timeline.y2024: Beyond animation, I started creating courses, interactive lessons and multimedia experiences.
timeline.y2026: Creative Technologist. Building pipelines and scripts that connect motion, code and AI.

motion.intro: Animation is where I started and what I keep coming back to. I like trying different ways of making things move, from manual craft to keyframes, 3D and AI, and mixing them to see what comes out.

web.title: Built for the web
web.intro: I learned web development to build my ideas myself, not only design them. Since then I keep finding better ways to build: lighter pages, cleaner code and small automations that save hours.
web.edubites: eduBITES · Test Your Agentic Skills. Design, code and upkeep.
web.rpgLine: A browser game played with the arrow keys and the space bar.
web.decrypterLine: Turns a message into code and back again.

pipelines.aria: Automated YouTube pipeline: topic, script, voice, frames, edit, captions, upload, YouTube, analytics, comments, then back to topic
pipelines.title: …to pipelines.
pipelines.flow: The Bias Gap · automated YouTube channel
pipelines.intro: The Bias Gap is a side project. I wanted to see how far one person could take a YouTube channel, so I built the whole pipeline with free tools, from picking a topic to pinning comments. A self-run pipeline.
pipelines.aa: A ScriptUI panel for After Effects. One click adds entrances, exits, elastic scale, fades and subtle camera moves to any layer. Built with expressions, so animations adapt when you trim. Also sequences, precomposes and copies the current frame.
pipelines.srt: Load a voiceover transcript (.srt) and a cut sheet, and it places every image layer where its line is spoken. An hour of manual timing becomes one click.

desc.topic: Pick a bias from the backlog, ranked by what performs
desc.script: Write the short script in markdown
desc.voice: Generate the voiceover with a cloned voice
desc.upload: Upload with title, description and schedule

automation.title: Automation
automation.intro: Plugins I built for After Effects, made to measure for recurring projects. They take the repetitive steps out of the workflow, so more time goes into the parts that need a human eye.

toolbox.title: Toolbox
toolbox.intro: What I open every day to animate, edit, generate and build.
